newsitem.title: ARMENIA: Armenian foreign-backed gold projects advance.
newsitem.headline: Armenian foreign-backed gold projects advance.

text.p: Global Gold Corporation of the United States and Kilborn Engineering of Canada have agreed the stages of a multi-phase project with Armenia to process and mine gold, a government official said on Thursday.

First Deputy Industry Minister Miron Shishmanyan said Global would finance construction of a gold-tailings reprocessing plant for Ararat gold recovery factory, near the capital, to begin operating in September.

He also said that Global subisidiary Global Gold Armenia planned to mine gold at the Zod and Megradzor mines, which may contain 5.9 million ounces, but that final agreements on these projects had not yet been signed.
Interfax news agency said Kilborn had an agreement with Armenia's state-owned Gidrospetsstroi construction firm to build the reprocessing plant.
It said last year that the Ararat plant had accumulated 10-12 million tonnes of gold scrap, with a content of up to one gramme per tonne.
